name: BLS International Services Ltd
about: BLS International Services Limited (BLS), a part of the four-decades-old BLS Group with a global presence and diversified range of services, and is the biggest global players in visa application outsourcing.[1]
keyPoints: Business Segments [1] 1) Visa and Consular Services (61% in FY26 vs 75% in FY25): [2] [3] The company ranks among the top 2 global providers of visa, passport, consular, and citizen services, operating across 80+ countries and serving more than 46 government clients. In 2024, it held a 17% market share by value and 10% by volume in the global visa outsourcing market (excluding the U.S.). It's service offerings include outsourced visa processing, document verification & attestation, biometrics, E-Visa, photocopy, courier & internet facility, insurance, translation services, passport renewal, authentication of travel documents, etc.
pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 68.2% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 32.6%
Company's median sales growth is 25.0% of last 10 years
